script.title: ASKING FOR A PRICE MATCH
script.scene_zh: 家電店櫃台 · 要求比價
script.story_hook: A cheaper ad, a dented box, one sweet deal.
script.intro_zh: 一則更便宜的廣告，一個凹掉的箱子，一筆好成交。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, my friend! Today we ask a store to match a price.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，我的朋友！今天我們請商店比價。
script.outro: What a deal, right? Listen once more and join in.
script.outro_zh: 多划算的一筆！再聽一遍，一起加入。
script.practice_intro_en: Say each sentence after me, loud and clear.
script.practice_intro_zh: 大聲清楚地，跟我一句一句說。
script.char_a_description: a broad-shouldered man in his forties with sandy short hair and stubble, wearing a rugby striped sweater and cargo shorts, rubbing the back of his neck while negotiating
script.char_b_description: a poised woman in her forties with a dark bob showing one blonde streak, wearing a burgundy blazer and pearl earrings, leaning on the service counter thoughtfully
script.youtube_title: 【🏷️比價英文】😮「你們會比價嗎」💰凹損折扣再加碼，聽一遍就會談｜Electronics Price Match English
script.youtube_title_en: “Do You Price Match?” — Working a Deal at the Electronics Counter
script.youtube_description:
別處賣比較便宜，可以請商店降價嗎？這段比價談判對話讓你學會聰明砍價！在家電店櫃台，跟著 Mark 一起出示促銷截圖、確認同款型號、爭取凹損折扣與免費配送。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就會開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Found the same item cheaper across town? This price match dialogue teaches you the polite art of the deal. Follow Mark at the electronics counter as he shows a competitor ad, confirms the model number, and wins damage discount plus free shipping — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus line-by-line repeat practice in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
youtube_tags: how to ask for a discount
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏷️比價英文｜出示促銷廣告・確認同款型號・談下折扣｜聽完就會用｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
同一台氣炸鍋，別家便宜四十塊，該怎麼辦？
「你們會比價嗎」這句話怎麼開口？

這一集帶大家走進家電店服務櫃台，Mark 拿著促銷截圖，從請求比價、確認型號，到為凹損的紙箱再爭取一成折扣，最後還談到免費配送。

你會聽到：
🏷️ 請求比價：例如「do you price match with other stores?」、「show me today's ad, please」。
🔢 確認同款：例如「model number's identical」、「it's forty dollars less」。
💰 談出好價格：例如「I can mark ten percent off」、「free shipping on this one」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次看到更便宜的廣告，別客氣，把手機截圖拿出來！
script.thumbnail_action: showing a price screenshot on a phone

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, do you price match with other stores?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ du ju ˈpraɪs mætʃ wɪð ˈʌðər stɔːrz/
dialogue.zh: 請問你們會比照其他商店的價格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do! Show me today's ad, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi duː ʃoʊ mi təˈdeɪz æd pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 會啊！請給我看今天的促銷廣告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's a screenshot — same air fryer at MegaMart.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz ə ˈskriːnʃɑːt seɪm ɛr ˈfraɪər ət ˈmɛɡə mɑːrt/
dialogue.zh: 這是截圖，同一款氣炸鍋，MegaMart 在賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Model number's identical, I'll admit that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's forty dollars less. That stings a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈfɔːrti ˈdɑːlərz lɛs ðæt stɪŋz ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 便宜四十塊，看了有點心痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True. But this box got dented coming in back.
dialogue.phonetic: /truː bʌt ðɪs bɑːks ɡɑːt ˈdɛntɪd ˈkʌmɪŋ ɪn bæk/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，但這台的箱子在後倉撞凹了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a dented box get its own discount?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ə ˈdɛntɪd bɑːks ɡɛt ɪts oʊn ˈdɪskaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 箱子凹了，會另外打折嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, sharp! I can mark ten percent off.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑː ʃɑːrp aɪ kæn mɑːrk tɛn pərˈsɛnt ɔːf/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，好敏銳！我可以再扣一成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, match the price and another cut? No tricks?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt mætʃ ðə praɪs ənd əˈnʌðər kʌt noʊ trɪks/
dialogue.zh: 等等，比價之後再降，不會有陷阱吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No tricks, I promise, it's my job here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ trɪks aɪ ˈprɑːmɪs ɪts maɪ dʒɑːb hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 沒陷阱，我保證，這就是我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what's the final damage, honestly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's see... ninety-nine plus tax, my friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts siː ˈnaɪnti naɪn plʌs tæks maɪ frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 我想想……九十九塊，再加上稅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal! Can it be delivered Saturday morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /diːl kæn ɪt bi dɪˈlɪvərd ˈsætərdeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 成交！可以星期六上午送來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free shipping on this one, there by Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /friː ˈʃɪpɪŋ ɑn ðɪs wʌn ðɛr baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這台免運，星期五前就會送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better than planned. Where do I sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər ðæn plænd wɛr du aɪ saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 比想得還順利。我要在哪裡簽名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here. I'll pack your dented hero now.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt hɪr aɪl pæk jɔːr ˈdɛntɪd ˈhiːroʊ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，我幫你把小英雄打包好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, perfect. Thanks for playing fair with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑː ˈpɜːrfɪkt θæŋks fɔːr ˈpleɪɪŋ fɛr wɪð miː/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝你這麼講道理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you! Have a delicious weekend ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju hæv ə dɪˈlɪʃəs ˈwiːkˌɛnd əˈhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 該說謝謝的是我，週末做菜愉快！
